title: Days 29 to 31 invoiced in January fall on Feb 28 in 2027
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Three customers on terms due on the 29th, 30th and 31st of the following month are invoiced in January 2027.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customers {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C} hold the shop's own terms {Term-A} (day 31 of the following month), {Term-B} (day 30) and {Term-C} (day 29).
    For example: the customers are ZZAUTOTEST DATA-05 A, B and C, and the terms ZZAUTOTEST DATA-05 D31, D30 and D29.
  • Work orders {Work-order-1}, {Work-order-2} and {Work-order-3}, for {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C}, are complete and ready to invoice.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-15440, {Work-order-2} is S2-15441 and {Work-order-3} is S2-15442.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1}'s Finance tab.
  2. Set Invoice Date to Jan 20, 2027.
  3. Open {Work-order-2}'s Finance tab.
  4. Set Invoice Date to Jan 20, 2027.
  5. Open {Work-order-3}'s Finance tab.
  6. Set Invoice Date to Jan 20, 2027.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the invoice preview shows.
  • Step 2: the Due date reads Feb 28, 2027 (2027 is not a leap year; February has 28 days, fewer than 31).
  • Step 3: the invoice preview shows.
  • Step 4: the Due date reads Feb 28, 2027 (fewer than 30).
  • Step 5: the invoice preview shows.
  • Step 6: the Due date reads Feb 28, 2027 (fewer than 29).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S7-R3: “When the following month is shorter than the term's day, the due date is that month's last day: day 31 invoiced in October is due Nov 30; day 30 or 31 invoiced in January is due Feb 28 (Feb 29 in a leap year); day 31 invoiced in March is due Apr 30.”
